components.adversarial_verification: A 35-agent wide test across all three served surfaces confirmed a further set of defects, fixed here: the Fear & Greed scale was painted with four different ramps and ran in opposite directions on the console versus the strip/block/splash/widget (now one FG_RAMP, one direction, five surfaces); the zone bars still carried the retired teal/brick and contradicted their own FG_COLORS table; the trend arrowhead resolved to a retired hue on the flipped axis; and the tertiary greys failed 4.5:1 on the new panels. A 27-agent review panel over the real screenshots and the source confirmed six defects AFTER the first merge, all fixed here: HS.card had overflow:hidden without minHeight:0 so grid children could not shrink and the r2 cards overran their track at 1280x800; the scroll fade was unconditional and ghosted the final row of live data; the weight gutter sat on the <th> only, so the header hung ~15px off its column and values collided with the bar; gauge captions were <text> inside a meet-scaled SVG (~6px at 1280, oversized at 1920) and are now HTML at fixed size; the chart reserved 55-60% of its plot for a band the score has never reached; and the legend separated label from value by up to 640px with nothing between. Built and screenshotted in headless Chromium at 1280x800 / 1440x900 / 1920x1080 and iterated four times against those images; then reviewed by an independent three-lens panel (visual craft / number honesty / a11y+robustness) over the same screenshots and the source. Defects found and fixed this way: section mounted 324px down and inside the 1060px column; clipped y-axis numerals; gauge overflowing its card so the legend was swallowed by overflow:hidden; sparklines reading a live.series field the feed does not expose; a table row sliced at 800px height; and a "VIX" legend showing multiplier/2 as a percentage. Verified in a real browser, NOT only by static render. 2026-09-10 (DR-015): resolveActivation (query key, sessionStorage persistence, demo/fixture keys, ?status-api-off) replaced by resolveApiBase (constant label + hostname only); the four embedded demo fixtures moved verbatim into acceptance/golden/api-*.fixture.json (extracted by executing the pre-change module, not retyped) so the re-frozen acceptance suite now drives the REAL fetch/validation path against them, and the unreachable-API path (connection refused) is asserted to yield the static atlas with labeled static/unavailable states and no fabricated reading. Bundle shrank 101,177 -> 90,415 bytes; 66-compiled-fresh, 71-perf-budget green.
